points.label: Claim about Job
points.left: God’s sons present themselves. Satan speaks. Job is commended. Motives are disputed. The LORD allows Satan to act but sets a limit.
points.right: Satan returns, Job’s integrity is named, a new limit is set, sores follow, and Job answers his wife.

payload.posture: Read both WEBU passages side by side. Keep each passage’s actors, setting, order, and identity claims distinct.

payload.tension: The second scene repeats the heavenly setting. It changes how far Satan may go and what he claims will expose Job.
